_doc: Edge-case catalogue by feature kind. Seeds a spec so gaps are surfaced before code. Each entry: what, why missed, and the test that would catch it.
universal: Concurrent duplicate request (double-click, retried POST)
happy path is single-threaded in the author's head
two parallel requests with the same idempotency key produce one effect
Partial failure mid-operation
multi-step writes are written as if atomic
inject a failure between step 2 and 3; assert no partial state remains
Downstream dependency times out
local dev is always fast
stub the dependency with a delay beyond the timeout; assert a bounded error, not a hang
Downstream returns malformed or unexpected shape
the type says it cannot happen
feed a response that violates the schema; assert it is rejected at the boundary
Empty, single-item, and very large collections
examples always have 3 items
tests at 0, 1, and a size past the pagination limit
Unauthorized and wrong-tenant access
only the authorized path is exercised
role A cannot read role B's record; assert 403/404, not 200
Clock skew, DST boundary, timezone of the caller
the author's machine is UTC
freeze time at a DST transition and at 23:59 local
Input at boundary sizes and with unicode/emoji/RTL
tests use ascii names
max-length, over-max, and multibyte input
Rate limit or quota exhausted
quota is never hit in dev
drive past the limit; assert a typed error and no data loss
Rollback path actually works
rollback is written, never run
execute the down/rollback and assert the prior state is restored
auth: Session revocation is immediate on logout, password change, and admin ban
revocation is assumed to follow from token expiry
revoke, then assert the next request with the old credential fails
Concurrent logins from multiple devices, and logout scope
single-device mental model
two sessions; logging out one does not kill the other unless specified
Credential stuffing / brute force on the login endpoint
rate limiting is 'infra's job'
N failed attempts triggers lockout or backoff; assert it
Timing difference between unknown-user and wrong-password
both return 401 so it looks fine
measure both paths; they must not be distinguishable
Password reset token reuse, expiry, and single-use
token is generated and forgotten
reuse a consumed token; assert rejection
Email enumeration via signup, reset, or login errors
error messages are written for humans
responses for existing vs non-existing accounts are identical
Session fixation on privilege change
the session id is kept across login
assert the session id rotates on authentication and on role elevation
Open redirect in the post-login return URL
the redirect param is trusted
pass an external URL; assert it is rejected or allowlisted
CSRF on state-changing auth routes
SPA assumed immune
cross-origin POST without the token is rejected
Cookie flags: httpOnly, Secure, SameSite, correct domain and path
defaults are assumed safe
assert the Set-Cookie header attributes explicitly
Account lockout is not itself a denial-of-service on the real user
lockout is added for safety
attacker-triggered lockout must not permanently lock a victim
MFA enrolment, recovery codes, and the lost-device path
MFA is added as a happy path
recovery flow works and recovery codes are single-use
OAuth: state parameter, PKCE, and mismatched redirect_uri
the provider is trusted to handle it
missing/replayed state is rejected
Token or session leakage in logs, URLs, or error messages
logging is added for debugging
grep logs for the credential after a full login flow
Password storage uses a slow KDF with per-user salt, and the cost is tuned
any hash looks like hashing
assert the algorithm and cost factor, not just that a hash exists
crud: Optimistic concurrency: two writers on the same record
version/etag conflict returns 409 rather than silently overwriting
Soft delete vs hard delete, and reads that must exclude deleted rows
delete is treated as one operation
a deleted record is absent from list, search, and aggregate counts
the FK is declared and forgotten
delete a parent with children; assert the intended cascade or block
Mass assignment: client sets a field it should not own
the DTO is spread into the model
post an extra privileged field; assert it is ignored or rejected
Pagination stability while data changes underneath
insert during pagination; assert no duplicate or skipped row with cursor paging
Uniqueness enforced in the database, not only in application code
two concurrent inserts of the same unique value; one must fail
payment: Idempotency on charge retries
network retry duplicates the charge
same idempotency key twice charges once
Webhook arrives before the local record is committed
webhooks are assumed to be slower
process a webhook for an unknown local id without losing it
Webhook replay and out-of-order delivery
webhooks are trusted as once-and-ordered
replay an old event; assert state does not regress
Webhook signature verification
the endpoint is 'secret'
unsigned or wrongly-signed payload is rejected
Currency, rounding, and minor units
floats are used for money
assert integer minor units end to end; no float arithmetic
Partial refund, over-refund, and refund after dispute
refund is modelled as the inverse of charge
over-refund is rejected
Reconciliation when the provider and local state disagree
provider is assumed authoritative and reachable
a scheduled reconcile detects and reports drift
upload: File type validated by content, not extension or client MIME
rename a script to .png; assert rejection on content sniff
Size limit enforced before buffering the whole file
the framework default is assumed sane
stream a file past the limit; assert early rejection without memory blowup
Filename path traversal and unicode normalisation
the name is used as given
a name containing ../ cannot escape the target directory
Virus/content scanning decision recorded (even if the decision is 'no')
scanning is out of scope silently
the decision exists in the decision log
Orphaned uploads when the referencing record fails to save
upload and record are treated as one step
fail the record write; assert the blob is cleaned up or reaped
interrupt and resume; assert one object, not two
search: Query with zero results, and with pathological input (very long, regex-like, wildcards)
assert bounded time and a clean empty state
the client library is assumed to escape
a query containing DSL syntax is treated as a literal
Relevance changes are visible and reviewable
a golden set of query -> expected top-N, asserted in CI
search is assumed synchronous with the DB
assert the staleness window explicitly, or read-through
realtime: Reconnect with backoff, and state resync after reconnect
drop the connection; assert resync without duplicate application of events
deliver out of order and twice; assert idempotent application
Backpressure when the consumer is slower than the producer
the queue is assumed to drain
flood the channel; assert bounded memory and a shed/park policy
Authorization re-checked per message, not only at connect
auth at handshake is assumed sufficient
revoke mid-connection; assert subsequent messages are rejected
migration: run up then down then up; assert the schema and data survive
Expand/contract so old and new code can run simultaneously
old code against the new schema passes its tests
Long-running migration on production-sized data, and lock duration
tested on an empty dev table
measure lock time on a realistic row count
backfill is assumed to run once cleanly
interrupt the backfill and rerun; assert no double-application
integration: Third-party outage, and the degraded mode
stub a 503; assert the documented degraded behaviour
Retry policy with jitter and a cap, plus which errors are retryable
a 400 is not retried; a 503 is, with a bound
rotate; assert both old and new work during the overlap
Contract drift when the vendor changes a response
a recorded contract test that fails when the shape changes
